reviews.t: Excellent dual purpose, dual voltage hair appliance
reviews.x: I am loving this combo curling iron. I have used other curling/straightening irons in the past but most are barely adequate for either task. But this one is intelligently designed and excels at both. Switching between curling and straightening is easy - there is a "C" button on one side of the handle and an "S" button on the opposite side to engage each task. The curling clasp holds my long hair securely as does the straightening iron. Two features that are great are the long swivel cord and the

I have no complaints at all with the straightener. reviews.t: Simple to Use and Lightweight for Travel
reviews.x: I just came back from a trip and packed this curling iron in my luggage. It's described as "travel" but the length is about the same as other curling irons. The main difference is the weight - it's so light and functions as both a straightener and curler, so it does save space in my luggage. It works very well. I had never heard of this brand before but the curler works just as well as more expensive brands. To change from a curler to a straightener, you simply press the buttons "S" for Straight

It's good but not great. The straightener side does not close down enough to grab the hair so you have to keep going over the same hair for some straightening. Doesn't do a good job straightening compared to my other flat iron.

reviews.x: First I want to say that the customer service with this seller is absolutely phenomenal. They are so kind, and helpful. When it comes to the curling iron itself, it’s amazing. It’s so easy to use. It’s a dual barrel, so you can either curl, or straighten your hair. The digital controls allow you to control the temperature, and it has a cool LED display. I also love that this wand has a anti-scald tip on the end, so you won’t burn yourself. I love this curling iron. I also love that it’s a two in

The size of this is great for me to do big fold unders or uppers. I have more of a pixie cut. It was nice and hot within a minute or so.  It has automatic shutoff, a must IMO, and you can adjust the temperature easily with a wee switch. You merely push a button on the side--one to use the curler, the other one to use the flat iron. reviews.t: Clever styling product that saves space
reviews.x: I am normally skeptical of products that have two uses at once--in my experience, they typically don't do that great of a job--however, this combo of hair straightener and curling iron worked great!  To move between the two functions, you simply push a button.  It has a swivel cord which makes it easier to use.  I gave the product a 4 star due to the poor quality packaging--the cardboard packaging kept popping open on both sides allowing the product to slip out.

It heat very fast and the temperature is very stable . The only thing is that you may unplug the wand between uses because the power bottom is very sensitive and can be power on easily with just a touch and get hot fast . It comes with a carry bag very versátil especially for travel .

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the build quality, describing it as well made, sturdy, and substantial in the hand.
Many reviewers highlight fast heating and effective performance for both curling and straightening.
Several reviewers note the straightener plates do not fully close or grab hair well, requiring multiple passes.
Some reviewers find the curling side has trouble catching hair at the ends.
A few reviewers report problems using it while traveling abroad despite the dual voltage claim.
